name: hand-over
title: Hand a person's work over
description: Gathers the facts about the project from the notes and writes a handoff the new owner can read, with each line labelled observed or quoted.
say: Sam is leaving; hand over their projects.

inputs.name: project
inputs.prompt: Which project is being handed over?

steps.title: Gather the facts a handoff starts from
Write the handoff the new owner can read
steps.prompt: Write the handoff for the project {{inputs.project}} with /gt:gt-create handoff. Start from these facts: {{steps.facts.output.text}} Label every line as observed or quoted, add what was decided and why, and list the open items.

steps.title: Read the handoff before it is passed on
steps.message: Read the handoff Claude wrote. Say done when it is right to hand to the next person.
